calculation.expression: -(r_5 - beta_DXY * dxy_r_5) / (sigma_60 * sqrt(5)) * clip(1 + dispersion_60 / mean_abs_cross_sectional_return_60, 1, 2)
calculation.description: Fades each asset's five-day return after removing its 60-day estimated sensitivity to the observation-only DXY return, with volatility scaling and a bounded cross-asset dispersion amplifier. Inputs are available through the prior completed day. Higher values indicate stronger expected forward return.

validation.regime_notes: Positive five-day IC across 2020-24, 2025-27, 2028-29, and 2030-31; 2032 year-to-date has only four observations and is interpreted cautiously. Ten-day IC is positive in every reported regime.
